nav.tagline: Your Gateway to Citizen Welfare & Government Schemes

landing.heroSubtitle: Describe your situation in your mother tongue. PolicyPal uses Google Gemini to match you with central and state welfare schemes, track your shared documents, and provide step-by-step checklists.
landing.examplePlaceholder: E.g. I am a 42-year-old small farmer from Warangal, Telangana with 2 acres of land and annual income under ₹80,000...
landing.howItWorksSubtitle: From plain-language description to application submission in 3 simple steps
landing.step1Desc: Tell us about your age, occupation, family, location, and needs in English, Hindi, Telugu, or any of 13 Indian languages.
landing.step2Desc: Our AI evaluates official eligibility rules across central and state catalogs and highlights exactly what you need to confirm.
landing.step3Desc: Prepare a document like Aadhaar once, and see readiness update simultaneously across all qualifying schemes.
landing.whySubtitle: Designed to eliminate bureaucratic confusion for every Indian citizen
landing.whyFeature1Desc: Tick a document once. Watch readiness progress update across every scheme that requires it.
landing.whyFeature2Desc: Available in 13 official Indian languages with native scripts and complete RTL support for Urdu.
landing.whyFeature3Desc: Clear, grounded explanations of why you qualify and exact step-by-step checklists.
landing.whyFeature4Desc: Row-level database security, zero third-party tracking, and client-controlled session data.
landing.trustedByCitizens: 20 curated central and state schemes across 13 Indian languages
landing.ctaTitle: Find Every Welfare Benefit You Deserve
landing.ctaSubtitle: Explore 20 curated central and state schemes across 13 Indian languages with document readiness tracked across schemes.
landing.demoAccountPrompt: Want to test instantly? Use our 1-click Demo Account.

assessment.newCheckSubtitle: Describe your situation naturally. Our AI will analyze your demographic profile and match you with all qualifying government schemes.
assessment.promptPlaceholder: Describe your background, occupation, family size, annual income, state, and specific needs in plain language...
assessment.example1: I am a 38-year-old female farmer in Warangal, Telangana with 2 acres land and family income of ₹80,000.
assessment.example2: I am a 21-year-old college student from a rural family in Bihar seeking scholarship assistance for higher studies.
assessment.example3: I am a 45-year-old self-employed artisan in Lucknow, UP looking for small business loans and craft subsidies.
assessment.aiNotice: Powered by Google Gemini 3.5. We evaluate your situation against 20+ active national & state welfare schemes.
assessment.resultSubtitle: Based on your situation description and government eligibility criteria
assessment.assumptionsSubtitle: The following items were not confirmed in your description and may be required for full eligibility:
assessment.noMatchesFound: No matching schemes found for this query.
assessment.refineAssessment: Try adding more details about your income, location, or occupation.

documents.howItWorksNotice: Documents are shared across all welfare schemes. For example, marking Aadhaar Card as ready updates PM-KISAN, Ayushman Bharat, and PMAY simultaneously.
